faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Each COD order is analyzed by 24+ rules: customer history, amount, city, address, time of day, and more. The result is a score from 0 (safe) to 100 (suspicious). You set the decision thresholds.
faq.q2: Is it compatible with my YouCan store?
faq.a2: Yes. Setup takes 2 minutes via the YouCan App Store. nortoo automatically receives every COD order via webhook and scores it in real time.
faq.a3: Absolutely. nortoo is compliant with Law 09-08. Phone numbers are SHA-256 hashed, data is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt), and a full audit log tracks every action.
faq.a4: Yes. From the dashboard, you can adjust SHIP/VERIFY/FLAG/BLOCK thresholds, activate sector presets, and even customize each rule's weight (Pro+ plan).
faq.a5: By monthly bank transfer. An invoice is automatically generated with 20% VAT. The 30-day trial is completely free, no credit card required.
